text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Kris S! Give me more! Bring 
everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How far can a nameless bandit go?! Can she 
truly take on the world?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If I can pull it off against you...!! 
WOOOOOAAAHHH!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Tch!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Tap-chan, Kris S-chan... I won't lose 
either...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is he coming? Here comes Hishi Miracle?! 
No, but the leader isâ

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City!! Pulling away from an 
unprecedentedly star-studded lineup, she 
conquers the Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City bounded forward with high 
spirits, as if tap dancing across the 
crest of the waves.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has more than enough qualification to 
take on the world. That was proven in this 
race, but—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew... Did you see that, Kris 
S...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Unlike you, I don't have powerful backers. 
But when it comes to racing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Different... from me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There is no difference, Tap Dance City. 
—It is the same.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? We're not the same. Not compared to 
you, living in the Symboli household."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I am... not at Symboli. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I am "devoted"—to Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —!? Devoting myself... to her, you say!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. I am not being protected. I 
merely serve Symboli, and..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"You, too, are likely devoting yourself to 
someone. Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"It wouldn't have been a surprise 
whichever of them won today's match."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: We are—the same.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Kris S...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You... I didn't think you and I would get 
along, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: This is the best!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Hell yeah!! I'm running for the 
sake of my comrades!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If I can beat you when you're burning with 
that exact same passion— I can do this. 
Even against the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Hmph――good luck.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City laughed heartily, while 
Symboli Kris S offered a faint smile. For 
the very first time, a wind of the exact 
same color blew between the two.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For someone's sake, huh. All right, I will 
too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It might not happen overnight. But little 
by little, I'm gonna make miracles happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tap Dance City made her way back, 
bursting with triumph.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, with this, we have more than 
enough souvenirs for our overseas trip, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"She closed in on Silence Suzuka's running 
in the Kinko Sho, and today, she defeated 
Kris S, the strongest active racer!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now we can take on the challenge of 
claiming the first-ever Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe victory! The route ahead is 
completely clear!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer. About after we come back 
victorious—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To Tap Dance City, winning overseas seems 
to be a predetermined course.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Where should your domestic comeback race 
be? After returning home from the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe, where will you run...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I think it over. Whichever way it 
goes, we need to decide on her next 
domestic race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm going to run, I want it to be a 
race that elevates Tap Dance City's renown 
even further. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup... That's what first made me 
fall in love with racing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: That was a race Katsuragi Ace won.
choice_data_list:
Yeah, and an international invitational 
race at that.

Yeah, and an international invitational 
race at that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the perfect race to make a name for 
herself worldwide.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"That's good! Let's go with that! If I 
make a name for myself in the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe and then the Japan 
Cup...!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
My castle is complete! Now I can party 
like crazy with everyone forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final destination of our dream is in 
sight. However, there's something I need 
to tell you first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the conclusion we've reached... 
after countless calculations upon 
calculations.
choice_data_list: Tap, I need to consult with you.

Tap, I need to consult with you about 
something.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's with the sudden formality?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not impossible. You can enter, and 
there's a chance you could win. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is one thing that will be 
exceptionally difficult to pull off.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What is it, Trainer? Don't build up 
suspense, just spit it out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must tell them these words no matter 
what. And that is—
choice_data_list:
Tap, about the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “I'll leave my friends... behind.”
